title: Evidence flow fixes
details: Prevents the full course title from flashing before the concise two-line title is ready
Fixes the post-evidence learning screen so only the intended UI is rendered
Completed evidence opportunities can be opened again to add more evidence instead of leaving a blank screen
Keeps the v160 thumbnail and measured download progress improvements
summary: Evia v161 fixes the three issues visible in the latest phone recording without changing qualification data or saved evidence.
